title: 2026 waste-incineration Carbon-14 and fossil-CO2 QA controls

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring reporting and verification period for EfW and waste incineration

facts.source_fact: The voluntary waste-incineration MRV-only period began on 1 January 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Bind records to the voluntary MRV period.

facts.source_fact: Participation in the 2026 MRV-only period is voluntary.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat non-participation as a compliance breach.

facts.source_fact: There is no regulator fee for participating in the voluntary MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Keep fee status separate from emissions evidence.

facts.source_fact: There is no penalty for not participating in the voluntary MRV-only period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer enforcement from non-participation.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary period is intended to help eligible operators prepare for future UK ETS inclusion.
facts.expected_handling: Treat it as preparatory evidence rather than full-scheme surrender compliance.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary period covers combustion and process emissions from eligible energy-from-waste and waste-incineration processes.
facts.expected_handling: Attach activity scope to monitored emissions.

facts.source_fact: The waste ETS design distinguishes fossil-origin CO2 from biogenic CO2 for carbon-cost purposes.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve fossil versus biogenic carbon classification.

facts.source_fact: Biogenic CO2 from natural materials is distinct from fossil CO2 from plastics and synthetic fossil-derived materials.
facts.expected_handling: Do not combine fossil and biogenic fractions without provenance.

facts.source_fact: A core scientific challenge is determining the origin of CO2 emitted when mixed waste is burned.
facts.expected_handling: Require method evidence for fossil-fraction estimates.

facts.source_fact: Carbon-14 measurement is used as part of the approach to distinguish fossil and biogenic carbon in waste emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Carry C14 sampling and analytical provenance.

facts.source_fact: The Authority selected an integrated monitoring approach combining Carbon-14 and emissions factors for the voluntary period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not represent either component as the entire method when the integrated route applies.

facts.source_fact: Emission factors form part of the integrated waste monitoring approach.
facts.expected_handling: Version and source every factor used.

facts.source_fact: Waste MRV guidance was revised in May 2026 to include preliminary biomass-fraction emission factors.
facts.expected_handling: Mark preliminary factors and guidance vintage.

facts.source_fact: Preliminary emission factors are method inputs and are not direct site measurements.
facts.expected_handling: Keep factors distinct from measured sample results.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary-period inclusion threshold is based on the small waste incineration plant throughput threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the throughput boundary before scope classification.

facts.source_fact: Clinical waste incinerators and clinical waste at non-specialist facilities are included in the voluntary period.
facts.expected_handling: Do not exclude clinical waste automatically.

facts.source_fact: High-temperature incinerators primarily processing non-clinical hazardous waste are exempt from the voluntary period.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the exemption only to the stated primary-processing scope.

facts.source_fact: The voluntary period is intended to improve operator and customer understanding of future scheme participation and costs.
facts.expected_handling: Treat learning objectives separately from emissions values.

facts.source_fact: Full cost-exposure and final policy design are to be confirmed separately before full waste-sector inclusion.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat voluntary-period rules as final full-scheme design.

facts.source_fact: Waste-incineration fossil-carbon MRV applies at installation and process level, not parcel level.
facts.expected_handling: Prevent parcel-level inference.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach installation, waste stream and inclusion-threshold scope.
Carry C14, sampling and emission-factor provenance.
Do not convert installation MRV into parcel emissions.
